newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products firm, except lagging gas oil. [CORRECTED 10:35 GMT]
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products firm, except lagging gas oil. [CORRECTED 10:35 GMT]

text.p: NWE oil products were firmer on Tuesday with buying healthier, except gas oil which dipped as IPE gas oil futures came off, dealers said.
Eurograde gasoline traded at $211.50 fob Rotterdam for prompt delivery and at $208.50 fob ARA for delivery in the second half of the month. The deals represented a strengthening of about $1 a tonne.

Prompt deliveries remained firm in the run up to the UK budget, due on July 2, and the expectation of increases on excise on motor fuels. The June/July swap differential held at around $8 backwardated.

High sulphur fuel oil barges (corrects oil product from heating oil) traded from $83.25 fob Rotterdam to $84.50 in early trading. Later talk was around $84/$85 fob Rotterdam, a gain of $1 on Monday's close.
Traders said bunker demand appeared healthy with a few shorts in the market.
Heating oil barges, however, came off by about $1 a tonne as futures weakened. Demand remained poor.
